title: Otter Slip
shortDescription: A mud slip where the Collegium boats are supposed to rest.
longDescription:
The slip is mud, willow root, and one ring-bolt with no boat on it. Down, a flood-store keeps what the landing could lock. South, the camp has been using the river as a road.
North is the landing. East is the skiff-line. West is the rope-island.

fixtures.name: Empty Ring
fixtures.lookDescription: A ring-bolt with no painter. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: A ring-bolt set into the stone, worn bright on the underside where a rope has run against it for years. Marram oils these himself. There is no rope through it now, and the mud below the slip has no keel-mark in it.
